job.title: Warehouse Shift Lead – 2nd Shift
description: Northgate Distribution runs a 600,000 sq ft regional DC serving grocery and home-improvement retailers. Our sister company, Northgate Freight, is also hiring CDL-A drivers — see their separate postings.
Position summary
The 2nd Shift Lead runs the floor for a crew of 15–25 associates: assigning work, keeping the shift safe and on plan, and solving problems before they reach the manager.
Responsibilities
• Assign associates to receiving, putaway, picking and loading based on the shift plan
• Monitor productivity and accuracy in the WMS and correct issues in real time
• Lead the pre-shift safety meeting and enforce PPE and equipment rules
• Train new associates on equipment and standard work
• Report shift results, shorts and incidents to the Operations Supervisor
Requirements
• 2+ years of warehouse or distribution center experience, including at least 1 year as a lead or trainer
• Forklift certification, or the ability to get certified within 30 days of hire
• Experience with a warehouse management system (Manhattan, Blue Yonder, or similar)
• Able to lift up to 50 lbs repeatedly and work in a non-climate-controlled building
• Basic computer skills (email, Excel)
• High school diploma or GED preferred
Schedule
2nd shift, Monday – Friday, 3:00 PM – 11:30 PM. Overtime as needed during peak (Oct–Dec).
Pay
$22.50 – $25.00 per hour, plus a $1.00/hr shift differential. Benefits start day one.
